newsitem.title: HONG KONG: StanChart in Mellon trade processing pact.
newsitem.headline: StanChart in Mellon trade processing pact.

text.p: Standard Chartered Bank said on Wednesday it would provide international trade processing services to U.S. clients of Mellon Bank N.V. in Asia.
Under the network arrangement, Standard Chartered will provide letter of credit processing to Mellon Bank from its trade processing centre in Hong Kong, the bank said in a statement.

"Combining Standard Chartered's extensive branch network in Asia and its technologically advanced letter of credit processing hub in Hong Kong with Mellon's trade finance expertise creates a network with a distinct competitive advantage," Jamie Stewart, Mellon's vice chairman for wholesale banking and cash management, was quoted as saying.
Standard Chartered Bank is wholly owned by Britain's Standard Chartered Plc.
Mellon Bank N.A. is a subsidiary of U.S. financial services company Mellon Bank Corp.
